top_signals.title: UK boosts support to Ukraine with £10 billion package
top_signals.summary: The UK will give a further £10 billion of economic and military support in the largest ever package of financial backing for Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed Officials Left Interest Rates Unchanged
top_signals.summary: Jon Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Tom Keene host a special edition of "Bloomberg Surveillance" as the Federal Open Market Committee voted 10-2 to hold its benchmark federal funds rate in a range of 3.75% to 4% and leave interest rates unchanged. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Budget 2026 speech
top_signals.summary: Budget 2026 speech as delivered by Chancellor John Healey.

top_signals.title: Chipotle shares rise 7% after CEO says same-store sales growth will continue
top_signals.summary: For the full year, Chipotle reiterated its previous forecast that its same-store sales will increase by a low single digit percentage.
